RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_MIXED_BOMB_POWER.desc: At the start of your turn, deal {Amount} damage to all enemies. Whenever you apply a negative status to an enemy, deal {Amount} damage to them.
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_MOONLIGHT_GREATSWORD_: Attack damage doubled, enemy attack damage doubled.
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_MOONLIGHT_SHIELD_POWE: Skill [gold]Block[/gold] doubled, attack damage reduced by 50%.
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_MOONLIGHT_BLADES_POWE: Whenever you play a card, draw {Draw} cards.
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_QUEEN_HARP_POWER.desc: At the start of each turn, apply 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] to all enemies, gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_HERO_DETERMINATION_PO: At the start of each turn, gain {Guard} Guard. When you play an Attack card, deal additional damage equal to your current Guard.
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_GUARD_POWER.title: Guard
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_GUARD_POWER.descripti: At the end of your turn, gain 1 [gold]Block[/gold] for each stack of [gold]Guard[/gold]. Whenever you lose [gold]Block[/gold] gained from [gold]Guard[/gold] due to an enemy attack, lose the corresponding number of [gold]Guard[/gold] stacks.
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_CURSE_REVEAL_POWER.de: Attack damage doubled, Skill [gold]Block[/gold] doubled, enemy [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] effects doubled, draw {Draw} cards whenever you play a card.
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_QUEEN_AXE_POWER.title: Primeval Battlecry
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_QUEEN_AXE_POWER.descr: Attack cards you play this turn deal double damage.
TEMPORARY_STRENGTH_POWER.description: At the end of your turn, lose {Amount} [gold]Strength[/gold].
TEMPORARY_STRENGTH_DOWN.description: At the end of your turn, recover {Amount} [gold]Strength[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_GOLD_TOUCH_POWER.desc: In this combat's victory rewards, gain additional gold equal to 100% of the gold reward.
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_JADE_RABBIT_MOCHI_POW: Queen Weapon powers can stack, and Queen Weapon cards gain Retain.
RAS_FOR_STS2_POWER_FARRAH_HELL_ASH_POWER: Whenever a card is Exhausted, gain {Amount} Guard.
